scope: Quiescent Aurora major upgrade; synthetic typical profile, one run per case. Data API availability only; no production downtime guarantee.

errors.message: FATAL: shared memory segment sizes are configured too large; total requested: 6330675200 (buffer cache: 40960, main segment: 5761819280, 65536 buffers), system total memory: 5158047744.

runs.notes: One run per case; physical sizes include normal TOAST and indexes. No padded/uncompressed size targets. Data API availability is not wire-protocol downtime. AWS reported pg_upgrade failure at 2026-10-12T18:20:21.707Z. Operator stopped polling after verified rollback to 16.15; KeyboardInterrupt records that stop, not the AWS failure cause. Source postmaster requested 6330675200 shared-memory bytes against 5158047744 system-memory bytes. No upgrade retry or capacity change. Post-rollback counts match all five relations. The modify CLI exited successfully with empty stderr; failure occurred later inside managed pg_upgrade. No successful upgrade_elapsed_seconds exists. Final cleanup independently verified: DELETE_COMPLETE, cluster/writer/managed secret absent, no cluster snapshots. Publication stage reconciled to failed_rollback from the preserved AWS failure event and independently verified source-version recovery; original error stages remain unchanged.
